svg.aria-label: The writing loop: phdude write assembles the context, the agent drafts, submit runs five gates, a block returns findings and writes nothing, a pass records the section, deslop revises it, and a decision approves it.
svg.title: The writing loop: phdude write assembles the context, the agent drafts, submit runs five gates, a block returns findings and writes nothing, a pass records the section, deslop revises it, and a decision approves it.
svg.text: Only the CLI writes under manuscript/. Approval is a human act: a decision you approved, naming the section.
